<!-- pr-reviewer: 8cc137f350bf98fd5b1b1cd17f04e0caabbffdf3 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge**

Thanks, @mkinney. This is a clean, behaviour-neutral split.

**What looks good**
- `rest.rs` goes 424 -> 245 lines and the new `rest/ahead.rs` is 193 lines, so both are under the ~400-line limit.
- The moved code matches the removed code except for `pub(super)` visibility and the two `super::` doc links. No unwrap/expect/panic was added.
- The new module has a provenance header, the public API is unchanged, and the PR body has `Changelog: none` and `Fixes #127`. The commit subject is conventional.
- No `CHANGELOG.md` edit, no dependency change, no build.rs/scripts/.github change.

**Local results (PR merged with current main; the trial merge was clean)**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run` | builds |
| `drill_prior` | 10 passed |
| `drill_prior_kinds` | 4 passed |
| `vertical_rapid_stock` | 4 passed |
| `remachining` | 6 passed |
| `camcraft-app --lib` | 66 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- I did not re-run the two failures you reported (`drilling_cross_box`, `drilling_cross_spindle`) on main. They are outside this diff, which only moves code and keeps the hash seeds and field order, but the maintainer may want an issue filed for them.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
